scope: Explicit owner-requested deferred science intake. All canonical arguments and load-bearing runtime sources were read and independently checked. Historical README reports and complete source inventory/headings were read for salvage routing; historical proof/code bodies not used by the canonical result are NOT all freshly reviewed. They remain ungraded, with no claim of exhaustiveness or impossibility. Frozen original branches are kept; every included original blob will be bundled for ai/probes. No subagents or workers.

energy-moments-and-apparatus.residual: Uniform physical-process resource bounds beyond one-input swaps; joint growing-time/volume windows and moment-uniformity; distinguish weak energy laws from ordinary moments. Alternative PRE decay/cutoff witnesses and exact toy controls are historical support, not additional retained claims.

preparation-optical-readout.residual: Native physical preparation, positive-window microscopic rates, detector/readout and scale identification. Review historical mean-energy optimizer, continuum overlap improvement, two-probe geometries, positive-time power and preparation-error extensions independently before promotion. Do not equate reference photons, bare counts, actual energy, heat or absorption.

ground-energy-and-response.residual: Stronger historical filling/activity, late-time budget and normal-state moment-free response results require separate proof/source validation. Landed fixed-graph ordered limits and fourth-moment response domain do not establish a selected physical vacuum, thermal reservoir, detector or infinite-volume law.

charge-threshold-and-transport.residual: Historical tighter finite-torus threshold, full auxiliary band, charge trace-distance, broader escape projector coefficients and formation-factor covariance remainder require separate validation. Test selected charged packets, finite-coupling/fixed-momentum binding, larger dressings, force/current/readout and calibrated scales; the landed global flat threshold and one escape target do not settle these.
